review.notes: Gate rerun fails only on readme-ids-missing=50: 49 genuine names, plus TauCeti.pi_withDensity misread because the file uses namespace TauCeti. Depcheck clean: 236 roadmaps, 2262 edges, 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with 54 sorry warnings and nothing else; all 136 #check @name lines elaborate; the 3 binders flagged as dropped are harmless. One-tactic probe on 10 declarations: none closes. Seeded sample of 15 sections: the README has one section-level locator in total, so no locator could be verified. Sources were not readable (L-C, L-R, Ferguson and van der Vaart paywalled; service failed for Brown, Blackwell and Sion). Adversarial table: 62 rows with computed values. P2 findings: 6.4 least-favorable prior not restricted to the null set (false); 3.5 missing N nonempty (false for Lebesgue measure); 4.3 Fisher matrix positive semidefiniteness needs L2 scores; 7.4 Scheffe statement underdetermined; 5.2 missing v > 0; statable headlines absent from Suggested.lean, with two stand-ins. P3 findings: gate, locators, no Checks, Needs lines and build order, 8.2 generality, namespace, padding, duplication (uniformOn, sampleWithoutReplacement, memLp_two_of_variance_ne_zero, CLT), vocabulary. 36 library declarations opened at the pins; 3 cross-roadmap citations resolved (StandardDistributions 4.6 and scope, MarkovChainsAndRenewal Layer 3); ownership checked against main and 458 open heads by name and by object, with no second owner found.
